title: Safety Intern
description:
**Company Description**
SVARP Global (SVARP Foundation) is a globally minded Indian organization focused on safety, sustainability, and skill development through consulting, training, and community outreach. The organization supports industries, academic institutions, and communities in building resilient and responsible practices aligned with international standards and local needs. With over 17 years of global experience in HSE, ISO audits, risk management, and capacity building, SVARP Global provides tailored solutions in safety and compliance, skill-based training, and sustainability integration. The team collaborates with corporates, universities, governments, and NGOs across India and Southeast Asia. SVARP Global’s mission is to foster a global culture of safety, sustainability, and resilience from urban industries to rural communities.

**Role Description**
The Safety Intern will support safety and EHS initiatives through data collection, documentation, and coordination of safety-related activities. Day-to-day tasks may include assisting with safety inspections, preparing reports, supporting accident and incident investigations, and helping develop training materials and awareness content. The intern will collaborate with senior safety professionals on projects related to occupational health, risk assessments, and compliance with relevant standards. This is an internship role based in Meerut, structured as a hybrid position, with some work-from-home flexibility depending on project needs. The role is designed to provide hands-on exposure to safety practices in consulting, training, and community-oriented programs.

**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge of Health & Safety and Occupational Health, with an interest in applying these concepts in real-world environments.
* Understanding of Environment Health and Safety (EHS) and Safety Training, with the ability to support the delivery or development of safety awareness sessions.
* Basic exposure to Accident Investigation and incident reporting, or a strong willingness to learn structured investigation methods.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in engineering, environmental science, safety management, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and research skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports and learning materials.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setting in Meerut, with the ability to collaborate both on-site and remotely.
* Interest in sustainability, ESG, and community safety initiatives is highly beneficial.

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**We’re hiring: Tender Executive (Government/PSU Tenders), Hapur, UP**

**Voltaire Power Systems has manufactured servo stabilizers and transformers since 1990, serving IAF, ONGC, BPCL and Indian Railways. We are building an in-house tender function and are looking for someone to own it end to end.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare technical and commercial bids, compliance sheets and BoQ inputs
* Submit bids on GeM, CPPP, IREPS and PSU portals
* Manage DSCs, EMD/PBG, and vendor and portal registrations
* Track every bid through to award, with follow-ups at each stage

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience with government tender submission
* Experience with electrical, engineering or EPC tenders preferred
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy

**Location:**
On-site, Hapur

**Salary:**
No bar for the right candidate

Interested candidates can send their CV, with a brief note on the portals they have worked on, to admin@voltairepowersys.com, or message me directly.

#Hiring #TenderExecutive #GovernmentTenders #GeM #Hapur
